name: Jiju Yu Guaiqi Shijian Bu
source:
~ WELCOME TO HERMITAGE! ~
But beware: Ye who enters here might start questioning reality as they knew it......

Investigate mysterious cases by taking on the role of a less than motivated bookshop owner, a former anthropology professor who for unknown reasons has never been seen outside of his bookstore.

With the help of a hacker genius on the run, a self-proclaimed detective and a short-tempered legal consultant, you must get to the bottom of a row of horrific incidents, bearing in mind the supernatural horrors that lurke within the pages of Hermitage's Lovecraftian book collection.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1225820/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
~ 欢迎来到冬宫！～
但要注意：进入这里的你们可能会开始质疑他们所知道的现实……

扮演一位缺乏积极性的书店老板来调查神秘案件，他是一位前人类学教授，出于未知原因从未在他的书店之外见过他。

在逃亡的黑客天才、自称侦探和脾气暴躁的法律顾问的帮助下，你必须查出一系列可怕事件的真相，同时牢记潜伏在赫米蒂奇洛夫克拉夫特式书籍中的超自然恐怖。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1225820/]Steam[/url]]
